sloka: सा त्वं मुनिवरं श्रेष्ठं प्रजापतिकुलोद्भवम् ।भज विश्रवसं पुत्रि पौलस्त्यं वरय स्वयम् ।। ७.९.११ ॥
transliteration: sā tvaṁ munivaraṁ śreṣṭhaṁ prajāpatikulodbhavam ।bhaja viśravasaṁ putri paulastyaṁ varaya svayam ।। 7.9.11 ॥

translations.english: O daughter, you yourself should choose and resort to Vishravas, the excellent and best of sages, born in the lineage of Prajapati and son of Pulastya.
